name: Outside-app integration (heca-pro): serve CLI, v1 read API, entity events, per-session focus
description:
Outside-app integration requested by heca-pro (docs/agent-plan-work.md), agreed with the user 2026-09-29. heca-pro drives the bundled agent-plan CLI from a Node helper, shows a read-only planner view and links to the web UI for editing; agents write through MCP. Assignment and roles remain outside agent-plan.

The original feature delivered serve/init CLI contracts (P110), versioned read-only /api/v1 and entity-changed events (P111), per-caller deviation stacks/resume focus (P112), and server discovery/reuse/stop/health (P113). Code ownership: packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts; packages/plan-server/src/api-v1.ts and serve.ts; packages/plan-core/src/session-focus.ts, task-selection.ts and plan-store.ts; packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts; packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts. API types remain in the harness-agnostic core and the Web UI's existing backend/event contracts are preserved.

P112 now has follow-up P112(F023)/T458 for four failures exposed by heca-pro P010(F003)/T031 on published 0.4.7: missing MCP focus entries, foreign-owner false success, concurrent starts both reporting success and restart retaining hidden old ownership. The implementation on wip/planner-session-ownership centralizes atomic claims and explicit task-referenced recovery in the core, persists MCP/Pi caller focus and preserves complete LIFO returns/checkpoints during recovery. T458 is completed locally. Focused real stdio MCP, core and Pi regressions pass, and the canonical final gate passed for fingerprint 51e94d842c96 with 910/910 Node tests, browser end-to-end and freshly packed installed ownership/focus/nested-return-recovery smoke. Changes remain uncommitted for user review. Publication and the downstream published-package recheck are separate release steps requiring explicit approval.

Preserve CLI JSON contracts, versioned read-only API with hidden internal session IDs, entity-changed notifications and old Web UI events, existing Web UI source rules, independent caller tasks, per-caller focus/LIFO/RESUME REQUIRED, sessionless project-wide behavior, legacy data and planner/dashboard activation only after an explicit user request. No assignment/role enforcement or automatic stealing of live task ownership is introduced.
